primitives.name: Transcription Cost Reduction
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Transcription: the biggest real arbitrage — move off OpenAI.** Groq whisper-large-v3-turbo direct at $0.00067/min ($6.70/mo per 10k min) vs OpenAI whisper-1 at $0.006/min ($60/mo): **~9×**.
primitives.assumptions: Groq's whisper-large-v3-turbo offers consistent performance at lower cost.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Cost efficiency improves linearly with increased batch size and reduced latency.

layer2.mapping: GSI's cost minimization algorithm aligns with Groq's transcription pricing structure.
layer2.telemetry: Monthly transcription minutes and associated dollar cost per minute.

For fleet inference, the NVIDIA NIM free tier (40 RPM, 10k req/day) acts as a foundational layer, absorbing initial workload before escalation to paid APIs. Transcription presents the most significant cost reduction opportunity by switching from OpenAI's $0.006/min to Groq’s $0.00067/min (~9x cheaper). Embedding costs are minimal when batched via HF→Novita or CPU, negating per-token pricing concerns. ZeroGPU fails as a scalable solution due to its low ceiling (~36k tokens/day) and volatile quota system. The mathematical structure reflects a layered cost optimization where each tier's capacity defines the next layer's activation threshold.
